name: ZER0-G
description: Anti-gravity racing over Neon City after midnight, out in deep space and across a red desert. Three cups of three courses with loops, pipes, drums and twisters. 18 machines, 30 racers, online races, and your own machine as a Project 0 entity. Arrows to fly, Space to drift, Shift for nitro. Open source: github.com/witnesstodark/zer0-g

credits.by: Stefan Vaskevich and Mr. Mak, all original
